function main()
    balances = Dict("Nina"=>12000, "Leo"=>3500, "Emma"=>800)
    transactions = [
        "deposit Emma 1200",
        "withdraw Leo 4000",
        "transfer Nina Leo 5000",
        "withdraw Leo 4000",
        "transfer Emma Nina 2500",
        "transfer Emma Nina 2000",
        "withdraw Emma 300",
        "deposit Nina 750",
        "transfer Leo Emma 3200",
        "withdraw Nina 9800",
    ]
    for (number, transaction) in enumerate(transactions)
        parts = split(transaction)
        operation, name = parts[1], parts[2]
        amount = parse(Int, parts[end])
        success = operation == "deposit" || balances[name] >= amount
        if success
            if operation == "deposit"
                balances[name] += amount
            else
                balances[name] -= amount
                if operation == "transfer"
                    balances[parts[3]] += amount
                end
            end
        end
        println("op $number: $transaction ", success ? "ok" : "failed (insufficient funds)")
    end
    for name in sort(collect(keys(balances)))
        println(name, ": ", balances[name])
    end
end

main()
